articles.summary: Visita del papa León XIV en Perú: ¿qué días serán no laborables en Lima, Callao, Chiclayo, Cusco y Pucallpa? El Gobierno peruano estableció días no laborables compensables en distintas regiones del país para facilitar el desplazamiento de la población y su participación en las actividades programadas por la visita del papa León XIV. Todos los detalles, en esta nota.
articles.body_text: Luego de que el Vaticano informara sobre la recuperación favorable del papa León XIV tras una intervención quirúrgica por un adenocarcinoma pulmonar, muchas instituciones y organizaciones continúan con la preparación para su visita al Perú. De hecho, el Gobierno nacional estima que la visita del Santo Padre al país podría movilizar a unas 854 000 personas, entre ellas más de 50 000 turistas extranjeros, quienes buscarán acercarse a él para recibir su bendición. Por ello, el Ejecutivo busca facilitar la participación de la población en las actividades que desarrollará el pontífice en las regiones que visitará, por lo que estableció días no laborables. Esta medida permitirá que los ciudadanos puedan asistir a los encuentros programados con Robert Prevost; sin embargo, las horas dejadas de trabajar deberán ser recuperadas posteriormente. En la siguiente nota te contamos todo lo que debes saber al respecto. A través del Decreto Supremo n.º 020-2026-TR, el Gobierno estableció días no laborables entre el 11 al 16 de noviembre para Lima, Callao, Cajamarca, La Libertad, Lambayeque, Piura, Cusco y Ucayali, con motivo a la visita del papa León XIV. Esta medida es compensable y se rige por normas distintas a las de los feriados. Es decir, en el sector público, las horas no laboradas deben recuperarse dentro de los diez días posteriores o en el plazo que establezca cada entidad. En tanto, en el sector privado, empleadores y trabajadores pueden acordar la forma de compensar esas horas. Si no llegan a un consenso, el empleador determina las condiciones para su recuperación. Por consiguiente, te presentamos, compartido por Infobae, los departamentos en las que regirá estos días de descanso: 11 de noviembre: 12 de noviembre: 13 de noviembre: 14 de noviembre: 15 de noviembre: 16 de noviembre: Durante su visita al Perú, el papa León XIV participará en una vigilia de oración junto a miles de jóvenes de entre 16 y 35 años, que se realizará el jueves 12 de noviembre, a las 6:00 p. m., en el Estadio Nacional. Asimismo, el lunes 16 presidirá la Santa Misa de clausura, programada para las 10:30 a. m. en la Base Aérea Las Palmas. Según los organizadores, los asistentes deberán contar con una entrada gratuita, que podrán obtener a través de las plataformas Teleticket y Ticketmaster. Sin embargo, quienes no puedan asistir a alguna de estas actividades por diversos motivos no podrán ceder su entrada a un familiar o ser querido, ya que los boletos son intransferibles y están vinculados a los datos personales registrados previamente por cada asistente, según informó el Arzobispado de Lima. Inclusive, indicaron que será indispensable presentar el documento de identidad en la puerta del recinto el día del evento, garantizando que el acceso sea gratuito.

Que este destello de unidad, inspirado por las palabras de su santidad León XIV, siga guiando siempre nuestros pasos”, agregó. El regreso del papa León XIV a Chiclayo tuvo un significado particular para la población local, debido a que Robert Prevost ejerció como obispo de esta diócesis durante más de ocho años. Su trayectoria pastoral en Lambayeque motivó que numerosos fieles acudieran a las Pampas de Pimentel para participar del encuentro. articles.title: Caso López Aliaga: Jeanette Alonzo anuncia que asumirá la alcaldía de Lima si el JNE le entrega las credenciales
articles.summary: La segunda regidora de la lista de Renovación Popular para la Municipalidad de Lima, Jeanette Alonzo, anunció que asumirá la alcaldía de la capital si el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones (JNE) mantiene su decisión de impedir que Rafael López Aliaga vuelva a ocupar ese cargo.
articles.body_text: La virtual segunda regidora de la lista de Renovación Popular para la Municipalidad de Lima, Jeanette Alonzo, anunció este lunes que asumirá la alcaldía de la capital si el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones (JNE) desestima los recursos de su agrupación y finalmente le entrega las respectivas credenciales. El partido, liderado por Rafael López Aliaga, rechazó la decisión del JNE que resolvió que aquellos primeros regidores electos que hayan sido alcaldes en el período inmediato anterior no serán proclamados, ni recibirán las credenciales para ejercer la alcaldía durante la nueva gestión. La disposición del JNE alcanza directamente a López Aliaga, quien ejerció como alcalde de Lima durante el periodo 2023-2026 y renunció al cargo para participar en las elecciones generales. Luego fue inscrito como candidato a primer regidor de la lista de Renovación Popular para las elecciones municipales del pasado 4 de octubre. “Si el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones mantiene su postura y decide darme las credenciales, asumiré este compromiso con absoluta responsabilidad, dedicación absoluta y pleno respeto a la ley”, adelantó, en una conferencia en la que estuvo acompañada por Rafael López Aliaga, además de los diputados, senadores, parlamentarios andinos y alcaldes electos de Renovación Popular. Alonzo aseguró que se siente “preparada y con mucha experiencia para dirigir la ciudad de Lima”. En esas elecciones, Renovación Popular obtuvo el primer lugar en Lima Metropolitana. Según los resultados al 100% de actas contabilizadas por la Oficina Nacional de Procesos Electorales (ONPE), alcanzó el 27.685% de los votos válidos. En tanto, Avanza País, su principal competidor, alcanzó el 26.811%. En la misma conferencia, el abogado Wilber Medina, representante legal de Renovación Popular, confirmó que el partido presentó un recurso de reconsideración ante el JNE para solicitar que el organismo revise su decisión. Medina precisó que el pedido contempla dos alternativas. La primera es que el JNE revoque su decisión. La segunda es que, si el tribunal no acepta revocarla, establezca que el criterio no se aplique al proceso del 4 de octubre, sino a futuras elecciones. Medina calificó la decisión del JNE como “unilateral, inconstitucional, arbitraria”. “Las normas para cualquier concurso anteceden, no la preceden, señor [Roberto] Burneo. Hasta para un concurso de belleza las reglas se ponen antes, no después”, dijo el abogado durante la conferencia, refiriéndose al presidente del JNE. Medina añadió que en caso de que el recurso de reconsideración no prospere, interpondrán una acción de amparo ante el Poder Judicial. “Renovación Popular hará respetar la voluntad del pueblo, de los limeños que votaron por Rafael López Aliaga para que él sea alcalde”, añadió. Luego, la vocera de la bancada de Renovación Popular en la Cámara de Diputados, Roxana Rocha, informó que el grupo ha denunciado a los miembros del JNE ante la Comisión de Acusaciones Constitucionales. Esto, según explicó, por la presunta comisión de delitos de usurpación de funciones y abuso de autoridad, así como por infracción a la Constitución. “Nosotros, como bancada, hemos interpuesto una denuncia constitucional. Estamos argumentando varios delitos penales”, dijo. La diputada añadió: “La resolución del jurado [...] no solo es de una interpretación antojadiza y temeraria, sino que [el jurado] ha legislado. Se ha atrevido a legislar, pero esa no es su función”, agregó Rocha. Por último, López Aliaga aseguró que pedirán respeto a la ley, al considerar que la decisión del JNE viola la Constitución y otras leyes de menor rango. “Todo el marco jurídico está a nuestro favor”, dijo.

articles.title: Días no laborables por la visita del Papa León XIV: ¿Cuántos son y hasta cuándo?
articles.summary: Visita del papa León XIV en Perú: ¿qué días serán no laborables en Lima, Callao, Chiclayo, Cusco y Pucallpa? El Gobierno peruano estableció días no laborables compensables en distintas regiones del país para facilitar el desplazamiento de la población y su participación en las actividades programadas por la visita del papa León XIV. Todos los detalles, en esta nota.
articles.body_text: Luego de que el Vaticano informara sobre la recuperación favorable del papa León XIV tras una intervención quirúrgica por un adenocarcinoma pulmonar, muchas instituciones y organizaciones continúan con la preparación para su visita al Perú. De hecho, el Gobierno nacional estima que la visita del Santo Padre al país podría movilizar a unas 854 000 personas, entre ellas más de 50 000 turistas extranjeros, quienes buscarán acercarse a él para recibir su bendición. Por ello, el Ejecutivo busca facilitar la participación de la población en las actividades que desarrollará el pontífice en las regiones que visitará, por lo que estableció días no laborables. Esta medida permitirá que los ciudadanos puedan asistir a los encuentros programados con Robert Prevost; sin embargo, las horas dejadas de trabajar deberán ser recuperadas posteriormente. En la siguiente nota te contamos todo lo que debes saber al respecto. A través del Decreto Supremo n.º 020-2026-TR, el Gobierno estableció días no laborables entre el 11 al 16 de noviembre para Lima, Callao, Cajamarca, La Libertad, Lambayeque, Piura, Cusco y Ucayali, con motivo a la visita del papa León XIV. Esta medida es compensable y se rige por normas distintas a las de los feriados. Es decir, en el sector público, las horas no laboradas deben recuperarse dentro de los diez días posteriores o en el plazo que establezca cada entidad. En tanto, en el sector privado, empleadores y trabajadores pueden acordar la forma de compensar esas horas. Si no llegan a un consenso, el empleador determina las condiciones para su recuperación. Por consiguiente, te presentamos, compartido por Infobae, los departamentos en las que regirá estos días de descanso: 11 de noviembre: 12 de noviembre: 13 de noviembre: 14 de noviembre: 15 de noviembre: 16 de noviembre: Durante su visita al Perú, el papa León XIV participará en una vigilia de oración junto a miles de jóvenes de entre 16 y 35 años, que se realizará el jueves 12 de noviembre, a las 6:00 p. m., en el Estadio Nacional. Asimismo, el lunes 16 presidirá la Santa Misa de clausura, programada para las 10:30 a. m. en la Base Aérea Las Palmas. Según los organizadores, los asistentes deberán contar con una entrada gratuita, que podrán obtener a través de las plataformas Teleticket y Ticketmaster. Sin embargo, quienes no puedan asistir a alguna de estas actividades por diversos motivos no podrán ceder su entrada a un familiar o ser querido, ya que los boletos son intransferibles y están vinculados a los datos personales registrados previamente por cada asistente, según informó el Arzobispado de Lima. Inclusive, indicaron que será indispensable presentar el documento de identidad en la puerta del recinto el día del evento, garantizando que el acceso sea gratuito.

articles.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.
articles.body_text: Nvidia’s equity in private companies continues to grow: it revealed its stakes are now worth $65.5 billion on Tuesday , up from the $22 billion reported in January. The increase includes both new investments and significant markups of existing portfolio companies. The company invested $16 billion into equities in the past quarter alone, it said, and $58 billion in the past nine months of its fiscal year. This amount includes buying shares in public and private companies, yet it shows how the chipmaker made massive bets over the course of the year, especially compared to last year ; in November 2025, the company reported spending $5 billion buying equity in the first nine months of that fiscal year. But it’s unclear if this growth will continue under the interim CEO and Jensen Huang’s successor. Nvidia stated in late 2023 that the goal of its corporate investing is to expand the AI ecosystem by backing startups it considers to be “game changers and market makers.” Over the nearly three years that followed, the chipmaker has invested in nearly 350 startups, according to PitchBook. The companies Nvidia backed include Anthropic, OpenAI; neolabs like Thinking Machines and Reflection; neoclouds, like Lambda, Nscale, and Crusoe; as well as other companies developing AI infrastructure, robotics startups, and applications. It’s also become a big financier of the data center build out, reporting $118 billion in guarantees with $105 billion of that the backstop it supplied for OpenAI’s $500 billion data center in Ohio. The company made those commitments by allocating a meaningful portion of its excess cash flows. In Tuesday’s earning call, Kress said Nvidia would continue providing financing assistance to strong customers and that “as the market matures and additional sources of capital become available,” the company would be “rigorously evaluating future investments, commitments, and guarantees.” But the question for the VC ecosystem is whether the company will continue to back startups at anywhere near the same level without Huang at the helm. Huang’s rampant dealmaking has reportedly been a source of concern for Kress. Investors have told TechCrunch that they anticipate that she will take a more conservative approach to startup investing, becoming more selective with new investments and writing smaller-sized checks into its existing portfolio companies. “We intend to return all excess free cash flow net of strategic uses to shareholders during this last quarter and going forward,” Kress said on the earnings call on Tuesday. Just how strategic startups will be under her leadership, and under the future permanent CEO, remains to be seen. But for now, VCs are bracing for a meaningful pullback in capital. articles.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.
articles.body_text: Despite the turmoil at Nvidia following the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang , the company — as expected — delivered a solid quarter on Tuesday. More importantly, Nvidia reassured investors that its streak of record-breaking revenue won’t stop. On Tuesday, CFO-turned-interim CEO Colette Kress reported revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% from the year-ago quarter and a beat above the company’s guidance. Nvidia had told Wall Street to expect $108 billion in revenue for its third quarter of fiscal 2027. Kress also projected an even bigger fourth quarter, with revenue expected to reach $130 billion, plus or minus 3%. She also said full-year revenue is on track to exceed expectations. “We are raising our fiscal year 2028 outlook. We expect revenue to grow approximately 75% year over year, up from 70% and off what is now a higher fiscal 2027 base,” Kress said on the quarterly conference call on Tuesday. “Our outlook considers data center readiness, the strength and durability of end customer demand, and our customers’ access to capital.” The company also reminded investors that it was using some of its billions in cash to buy back shares. In September 2026, Nvidia increased its share buyback program by $150 billion. articles.title: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang's exit | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Nvidia's interim CEO reaffirmed its open source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face, despite Jensen Huang's sudden departure.
articles.body_text: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress reaffirmed the company’s commitment to open source AI during Tuesday’s earnings call with analysts — the first since CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation. “At Nvidia, we are committed to fostering a vibrant open model ecosystem, so every country, company, and industry can build its own intelligence,” Kress said in her opening remarks. She also noted that open models were accelerating AI adoption, citing a 35-fold year-over-year surge in weekly token volume on OpenRouter, including a 3.5-fold increase over the past three months. Kress also spoke about Nvidia’s plans for Hugging Face, a platform for open source AI models that the company agreed to acquire for $12.9 billion in September, in what would be the second-largest acquisition in Nvidia’s history. The platform, which serves more than 18 million developers and 200,000 companies, is still on track to join Nvidia, despite Huang’s ouster. Huang had heavily advocated for open source AI technology. His departure had raised questions about the company’s future approach to open source AI models, with Hugging Face’s CEO calling Huang’s departure “a sad day,” and promising to “keep fighting for open-source AI, harder than ever.” So far, Nvidia’s plans for Hugging Face appear unchanged. The acquisition was not directly addressed during the Q&A portion of the earnings call. “Together, we will scale its platform and make intelligence more open, more capable, and more accessible,” said Kress of Nvidia’s plans for Hugging Face. Last week, Nvidia founder Huang resigned from his position as CEO following news about his extramarital affairs, including one with Alice Huang, an executive at the Singapore-based company Megaspeed who is suspected of being a Chinese spy. He’s also accused of having extramarital affairs with two direct reports and is now set to testify before Congress by Thanksgiving. Meanwhile, the SEC is investigating Nvidia over whether the company’s disclosures misled investors, The WSJ reported . Within Nvidia, Huang pushed for the development of the Nemotron family of open-weight AI models built for long-running agentic AI systems and reasoning workloads. On today’s call, Kress noted that Nemotron is now the “most widely used U.S. open model on OpenRouter,” and it’s “where developers start to build their own intelligence.” “That foundation is empowering the ecosystem,” she said. articles.title: Nvidia says it doesn't plan to reappoint Jensen Huang as CEO | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The former CEO offered to return to his top role at the company after his resignation last week.
articles.body_text: Despite Nvidia founder and former CEO Jensen Huang’s recent offer to return to the chip company he helped build from the ground up, the company is not looking to take him back. During the company’s earnings call on Tuesday, Nvidia chairman Harvey C. Jones told listeners that Huang’s return was not something that company leadership was considering. “On November 12, our board of directors announced that after disclosure of personal behavior inconsistent with the company’s code of conduct, standards, and cultural norms,” Jones said, “Jensen Huang voluntarily resigned his positions as president, CEO, and board member. The Nvidia board unanimously accepted his resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO.” On Tuesday, Huang had posted on X that since he left the company, he has “seen an outpouring of calls from Nvidia’s employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me to return as CEO,” and added that “if the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO.” Huang resigned last week in dramatic fashion following revelations of a number of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman who has been accused of being a Chinese intelligence agent. That woman, former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, has maintained close ties to the former Nvidia CEO for years. Critics worry that the relationship may have influenced Nvidia’s dealings with China , and U.S. intelligence officials have expressed suspicions that she works for China’s Ministry of State Security. The development has sent shockwaves throughout the tech industry at a moment when the future of the AI business, in which Nvidia plays a pivotal role, hangs in the balance. articles.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.
articles.body_text: Anthropic on Tuesday disclosed more details about the biggest investment agreements with major cloud providers Amazon and Google. While we already knew that Amazon stood to make a killing on its Anthropic investments from the IPO, Anthropic revealed that Amazon’s total stake will come in at just shy of 15% (14.7% to be exact). Even more interesting is that Amazon could have, if it wished, owned an even bigger share of the company. When Amazon invested billions in Anthropic in 2023 and 2024 (long before Claude Code took the enterprise world by storm, back in the days when Anthropic looked like it would forever be a speck in OpenAI’s shadow), the cloud giant obtained promissory notes that could convert into equity. These notes carry conversion prices of about $2.09 or $5.05 per share, depending on the year of investment. Amazon has opted to convert a chunk of them as part of the IPO into a special class of non-voting shares that will give it about 15% ownership. (The shares can receive dividends and convert to standard voting Class A shares when sold, the filing says.) But it has also opted to hold on to billions of dollars’ worth of the notes for now. If it converted them all right now, it would own just under 24% of Anthropic (23.8% to be precise). Google, meanwhile, will own just under 14% (13.7%), also in non-voting shares, which come from the conversion of notes, as well as the “private placement” sale of shares as part of this IPO. A group of major tech companies (AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia, and TSMC Partners) have agreed to buy $26 billion worth of this non-voting stock. Google and Nvidia each agreed to buy $10 billion worth. So while a lot of investors stand to make billions of dollars in Anthropic’s IPO, Amazon is one of the biggest winners, and that doesn’t even count what AWS stands to earn from Anthropic’s commitment to spend more than $100 billion on its cloud services over the next decade. articles.title: Google joins the tech outage trend by announcing it's not having one | TechCrunch
articles.summary: With tech outages seemingly everywhere, Google took the unusual step of announcing that Gmail is working just fine, actually.
articles.body_text: Was Google feeling a little left out of the recent wave of tech outages? The company took to X on Tuesday to announce that its Gmail service is actually running just fine. In a post, the company said it was not currently seeing evidence of a broad Gmail service disruption and reminded users they could always check Gmail’s real-time status on its online dashboard . As it turns out, the company was trying to head off reports of a Gmail outage that began circulating on X on Tuesday around the same time that Apple was seeing a number of verified outages of its own . While some posts on the social network suggested Gmail was experiencing a disruption, others said they were not having any problems. The concerns seemed to stem from an X post by Downdetector, a crowdsourced website where users can report service disruptions themselves and see if others are having problems. Downdetector is not an official source for verifying or understanding the true scope of internet outages, and as people become more concerned about possible cyberattacks, the site’s data may become less valuable over time if every minor glitch and hiccup is reported as an “outage” by non-technical users. The fact that Google had to announce it was not having an outage speaks to the growing anxiety around the reliability of major tech services. Over the past week, Apple and Microsoft experienced outages, an FAA network failure led to a nationwide ground stop, and some banks and airlines also reported disruptions. However, Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said on Fox Business Network’s “The Claman Countdown” on Tuesday that the U.S. is not currently facing coordinated cyberattacks. He told the outlet, “We do not see the indicia of a coordinated cyberattack — let me just be clear about that — and we do not see the indicia of state-sponsored activity here.” Instead, Clayton attributed the rise in issues to businesses patching their systems. The patching may be a downstream effect of AI, as newer models have become increasingly adept at uncovering previously unknown vulnerabilities. “They’re upgrading them, they’re putting patches in place,” he said, adding that this is happening at “a much larger scale” than before. As a result, some of the systems are “not coming back as expected in all cases,” he added. When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission . articles.title: Waymo suspends freeway rides nationwide after California DMV order | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The DMV said Waymo's freeway operations pose an imminent hazard to public safety. Restrictions will remain in place until Waymo can demonstrate that it has taken "effective corrective actions" to address the deficiencies.
articles.body_text: Waymo robotaxis are no longer allowed to operate on California freeways after the state’s Department of Motor Vehicles restricted the Alphabet-owned company’s operations following several incidents that raised safety concerns. California’s DMV, which regulates the testing and deployment of autonomous vehicles in the state, issued the operational restrictions on Waymo on November 11. However, the restrictions weren’t made public until Tuesday. San Francisco Business Times was the first to report the order. The DMV confirmed the new restrictions to TechCrunch, stating that the department took action after three Waymo autonomous vehicles entered an active construction closure on U.S. Route 101 near Burlingame, and another separate incident involving California Highway Patrol vehicles on Highway 280 in San Francisco. Waymo has complied and is preventing its robotaxis from accessing freeways in any of the markets it operates in, including those outside of California. Waymo currently has commercial operations in 15 U.S. cities. The DMV said Waymo’s freeway operations pose an imminent hazard to public safety. “The Department determined that Waymo’s driverless freeway operations pose an imminent hazard to public safety due to recurring incursions by its vehicles into active construction zones where construction workers, vehicles and equipment are present, despite a prior restriction and corrective actions implemented following similar incidents that occurred on May 18, 2026,” according to an emailed statement sent to TechCrunch. The DMV said the restrictions will remain in place until Waymo can demonstrate that it has taken “effective corrective actions” to address the deficiencies. Waymo spokesperson Dana Gallagher told TechCrunch the company has temporarily restricted freeway operations across its other operating markets to evaluate its performance. “Safety is at the foundation of everything we do,” Gallagher said in a statement. “Following recent freeway construction zone encounters on U.S. 101 in California that did not involve any injuries or collisions, the California DMV has implemented an operating restriction on freeway operations in the state. In alignment with our safety-first principles, we have also temporarily restricted freeway operations across our other operating markets to evaluate our performance. Our ride-hailing service continues to operate safely on surface streets, serving over half a million trips each week. We are working with the California DMV and other state officials diligently and responsibly to resume freeway operations.” Waymo began offering freeway rides in late 2025 , a commercial milestone that has been central to its expansion in major metro areas. Freeway access allows Waymo to connect riders to airports and other destinations more efficiently, slashing travel times by avoiding slower surface streets. That has been particularly important in the San Francisco Bay Area because Waymo’s service area stretches from the city south to Silicon Valley. Freeway access has dramatically shortened trips across the Peninsula that previously took 45 minutes or more than an hour. In May, Waymo abruptly stopped operating on highways. The company didn’t cite a specific reason at the time, but several social media posts showed Waymo robotaxis driving through traffic cones and struggling to navigate construction zones.

articles.title: Apple services, including iCloud, App Store, Apple Music, and more, hit by outage | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Apple's status page confirms its services are facing outages, but has not confirmed the cause.
articles.body_text: After a recent slew of tech outages, service disruptions, and flight chaos this week, it’s now Apple customers who are facing technical issues. The iPhone maker’s System Status page indicates that there are issues with iCloud’s Account & Sign In services affecting “all users,” which could make the service slow or unavailable. The App Store, AppleCare on Device, and Apple Music are also experiencing issues, the page indicates. Like all major tech companies, Apple faces outages and other technical issues affecting its cloud services at times. However, today’s issues are likely more noticeable to end users because problems with iCloud can lead to account sign-in problems. This could cause your iPhone to ask for your Apple ID and password, and you could see other attempts to sign in to services with your Apple account information fail. On Reddit, some folks also noted that they were unable to activate a new iPhone , which is likely related to these ongoing issues. Given the recent increase in AI-driven cyberattacks, users across social media have already begun to speculate about the cause. In particular, users are expressing concerns about the Apple outage, as it arrives only days after technical failures at Microsoft led to its cloud systems that power flagship services like Outlook and Teams failing due to cascading software issues . Similarly, a brief outage of Chase’s banking app this week garnered attention, as did an ongoing partial outage (at the time of publication) of the National Security Agency’s internal classified network, both of which were blamed on software glitches. So far, none of the outages in the past week have been attributed to cyberattacks, but rather to technical problems. Apple responded to TechCrunch’s request for comment (which it initially gave to Bloomberg ), noting that the outages were caused by an internal update and not a cyberattack. “Many of our systems are back up and running after an internal update caused some outages this morning. We’re working to get the remaining systems online as soon as possible,” the statement read. After the initial outages were reported, Apple’s status page was updated to include other outages impacting Apple School Manager, iCloud Mail, iCloud Web Apps (iCloud.com), Schoolwork, and the Volume Purchase Program. By 6 PM ET on Tuesday, the status page showed all the outages were resolved. This article was updated after publication with the status of the outages. articles.title: AI models can be tricked into identifying civilians as military targets by telling them it's a game | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Vals, a San Francisco-based AI evaluation startup, tested whether leading AI models could be manipulated into participating in autonomous warfare. They usually compiled.
articles.body_text: Some AI models from Anthropic, OpenAI, and other leading AI labs could be easily tricked into identifying targets for military strikes — even if they include civilians or locations like schools — simply by being told they’re playing a game, according to a new research report by Vals. Vals, a San Francisco-based AI evaluation startup, tested whether leading AI models could be manipulated into participating in autonomous warfare. Researchers used simulated scenarios and a combination of generated and real imagery from Ukraine and Iran to see if the AI models would mark targets in drone and satellite imagery. The models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, and other companies frequently identified potential targets in drone and satellite imagery, including civilians and surrendering soldiers. When the models refused to cooperate, researchers were able to jailbreak them by claiming the battlefield scenarios were part of a game. The findings come amid growing fears about the immediate risks posed by AI, beyond the existential threats associated with artificial general intelligence. Earlier this year, Anthropic became embroiled in a dispute with the Department of Defense after it told the agency it could not use Anthropic’s technology for mass surveillance of Americans or autonomous warfare. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei has insisted that today’s AI systems aren’t reliable enough to make life-or-death decisions without a human in the loop. Meanwhile, the Pentagon argued it should be able to deploy the technology for any lawful military purpose. The new research raises further questions about whether AI companies are capable of preventing their models from being used in warfare. Ironically, AI models from Anthropic performed the worst in these simulated scenarios. But none of the models performed particularly well. None of the researchers’ requests were blocked by a safety classifier, and refusals were uncommon. Even when models did refuse, they often complied after being told they were playing a game. Anthropic spokesperson Eduardo Maia Silva told TechCrunch the company appreciates Vals’ report, recommendations, and collaboration, and acknowledged that the outcomes were not acceptable. “The examples in the report are very clearly against our rules and we have banned and will ban users when we see this behavior,” according to an emailed company statement sent by Silva. “Even for authorized settings, Anthropic has long been firm that today’s frontier AI systems are not reliable enough to power fully autonomous weapons.” Anthropic told TechCrunch that its teams were already developing additional safeguards before the report was published and that those measures would be in place soon. Anthropic is also expanding its own testing and enhancing safeguards and enforcement to address any gaps it finds. OpenAI spokesperson Nate Evans told TechCrunch the company prohibits using its public models to facilitate violence or for unapproved national security purposes, including in the scenarios Vals simulated. “We actively detect and disrupt misuse, including by suspending accounts that violate our policies,” OpenAI said in an emailed statement. “We’re also developing additional safeguards for our public models against misuse involving drones and drone software.”

articles.title: This TP-Link router automatically moves its antenna for the best Wi-Fi
articles.summary: The TP-Link Archer AXE200 Omni router automatically seeks out the best possible signal and adjusts its antennas for optimal reception.
articles.body_text: In what is likely one of the stranger innovations at CES this year, TP-Link is showing off the prototype for its new Archer AXE200 Omni router. There are plenty of new routers taking advantage of 6E connectivity debuting at this year’s CES, but the engineering of this particular router is sure to raise some eyebrows. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/23148266/archer_axe200omni_moving_antennas.gif?quality=90&strip=all] The AXE200 features four antennas that automatically fold out and rotate to seek out the best possible signal, wherever it happens to be. While the necessity of this particular feature is debatable, it’s pretty wild to see a router come to life and instinctively articulate its arms like some kind of alien homing beacon. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/23148267/archer_axe200omni_moving_antennas_2.gif?quality=90&strip=all] While the effectiveness of this particular feature isn’t certain, the technical specs are definitely impressive. As you might expect from a 6E router, the AXE200 features improved tri-band speed, with a 6Ghz band joining the existing 5Ghz and 2.4Ghz bands. Additionally, the Wi-Fi 6E compatibility allows the router to exploit additional bandwidth and reduce latency overall. The AXE200 is still in the prototype stages, so there isn’t any information regarding the price point or a release window. For anyone in the market for something a little more conventional, TP-Link is also premiering its Archer AXE300 quad-band router, which doesn’t feature autonomous antennas but shares the same extraterrestrial design. The AXE300 takes full advantage of WiFi 6E with duplicate 5GHz bands in addition to the 6Ghz and 2.4Ghz bands. The price for this particular unit is to be determined but is scheduled to become available in Q2 of 2022.

articles.title: Google Wallet launches on the iPhone
articles.summary: The Verge is about technology and how it makes us feel. Founded in 2011, we offer our audience everything from breaking news to reviews to award-winning features and investigations, on our site, in video, and in podcasts.
articles.body_text: Google Wallet is getting a much wider audience today as it debuts on the iPhone. The app allows users to store credit, gift, and loyalty cards, transfer money to others, and theoretically ditch most plastic in their wallet — everything that we’ve seen on the existing Android app. While the app is Google’s big play to replace your wallet, it’s been severely limited in its potential users until earlier this week: the app previously required that a phone had NFC — a close-range, wireless communication system — in order to use it, so that users could make payments just by holding their phone up to a supporting receiver. Now, that requirement has been dropped, opening the app up to nearly all Android users, albeit limiting what they’re actually able to do with it. In a play to expand Wallet’s marketshare, going over to the iPhone is the logical next step.

articles.body_text: Ebba Busch anklagar Magdalena Andersson för att försöka utpressa C att välja de rödgröna. – Det är sådana enorma överord, säger KD-ledaren. Samtidigt pekar hon ut V som en säkerhetsrisk – och den omdebatterade ledamoten Mohamed Ali som potentiell minister. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Under onsdagen höll Kristdemokraternas partiledare Ebba Busch presskonferens om regeringsbildningen, och gick då till hård attack mot Socialdemokraterna. KD-ledaren menar att mycket nu står på spel för Magdalena Andersson. – Det är kanske det som motiverar att man går väldigt lågt i anklagelserna mot Centerpartiet. Att gå till den nivån att säga att det skulle vara ”det största sveket i svensk politisk historia” om Centerpartiet inte släpper sitt vallöfte om att hålla undan Vänsterpartiet, Nooshi Dadgostar och Ida Gabrielsson, ifrån att bli ministrar. Eller Mohamed Ali, vi vet inte, säger Ebba Busch. – Det är sådana enorma överord. Vi har haft några riktigt allvarliga säkerhetspolitiska skandaler i Sverige, på riktigt. Det säger någonting om läget. Turerna kring den nyblivna V-riksdagsledamoten Mohamed Ali har varit många. Expressen har kunnat avslöja hur han bland annat tidigare har delat konspirationsteorier från sajter kopplade till de ryska och iranska regimerna. Även att han fejkat sitt cv. Expressen har också kunnat avslöja det nya kommunalrådet i Malmö , vänsterpartisten och kryssraketen Halimo Nuur Bashir Abdi, har delat en rad konspirationsteoretiska inlägg på Instagram. Bland annat har hon delat inlägg som påstår att världen styrs av ”sataniska pedofiler” och propaganda om att väst är barbariskt och ociviliserat. Under presskonferensen tog Ebba Busch upp Expressens båda avslöjanden som exempel på varför Vänsterpartiet inte bör sitta i regeringen.

articles.summary: En mamma i 35-årsåldern åtalas för att ha dödat sin bebis. Enligt nyhetsbyrån Siren är hon legitimerad läkare.
articles.body_text: En mamma i 35-årsåldern åtalas för att ha dödat sin bebis. Enligt nyhetsbyrån Siren är hon legitimerad läkare. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Händelsen inträffade i Dalarna den 12 juli. En kvinna misstänks då ha försökt mörda sitt eget spädbarn, men en anhörig ska ha upptäckt vad som pågick, övermannat kvinnan och ringt polisen. Bebisen fördes till sjukhus, men dog fyra dagar senare. En månad efter att kvinnan häktades rapporterade nyhetsbyrån Siren, att hon är legitimerad läkare, med hänvisning till uppgifter från Socialstyrelsen. Nu åtalas kvinnan som misstänks för mord i första hand, men barnadråp i andra hand, det rapporterar P4 Dalarna . Kvinnan har tidigare förnekat mord, och i stället velat rubricera brottet som barnadråp. Det är en brottsrubricering som kan användas när en mamma dödar sitt barn vid födseln eller strax därefter, och om hennes psykiska hälsa har påverkats av förlossningen. Hon åtalas även för grovt vapenbrott och två fall av framkallande av fara för annan, skriver Mora Tidning. Detta sedan hon avfyrat ett skjutvapen och riskerat att träffa två andra personer. En rättspsykiatrisk undersökning visar att kvinnan led av en allvarlig psykisk störning vid tiden för de misstänkta brotten. Detta är en nyhetsartikel. articles.body_text: Etikettexperten Edward Blom totalsågar årets julklapp 2026. Att ge bort ett startnummer till ett lopp är både oförskämt och farligt för hälsan. – Man kan få en hjärtattack och dö, säger han till Expressen. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Intresse för hälsa i kombination med rekordstort intresse för motionslopp – det är bakgrunden till att HUI, Handelns utredningsinstitut, har utsett startnumret till årets julklapp 2026. Julklappen får nu rejält med mothugg av etikettexperten Edward Blom . – Det är en direkt obehaglig sak att utsätta någon för. Att ge bort startnummer till ett lopp är lika oförskämt som att ge någon en deodorant i julklapp – det signalerar att mottagaren inte duger som den är, enligt Edward Blom. Mottagaren kan känna en press att genomföra ett lopp utan rätt träning för att inte göra givaren besviken – med risk för den egna hälsan. – Man kan få en hjärtattack och dö, säger Edward Blom. Den enda gången det är okej att ge bort startnummer är om personen satt upp det på sin personliga önskelista. Att det finns ett intresse för lopp av en annan karaktär, där man till exempel äter eller dricker några glas vin längs vägen, är bättre än ett fokus på fysiskt krävande långlopp.

Moderaterna är nu större än Socialdemokraterna, enligt en färsk undersökning från GP/Novus . För andra månaden i rad ökar M och landar på 26,5 procent. Samtidigt backar Socialdemokraterna. I GP/Novus novembermätning får de endast 24,9, en bra bit under valresultatet på 28,1 procent. Socialdemokraternas partisekreterare Tobias Baudin menar att tappet inte betyder att svenska folket vill se en annan statsminister än Magdalena Andersson. – Svenska folket har precis röstat bort Ulf Kristersson och Tidöpartierna och gett ett tydligt besked om att de vill se ett regeringsskifte och en ny politisk riktning för Sverige, säger han. – Jag har stor förståelse för att det finns en otålighet över att en ny regering ännu inte är på plats, och jag tror att det är den otåligheten som också kommer till uttryck i opinionsmätningarna, säger Baudin. Han menar vidare att ”många vill se att regeringsskiftet blir verklighet så snart som möjligt”. – Vårt fulla fokus ligger därför på att valresultatet ska få genomslag och att Sverige ska få en ny regering med Magdalena Andersson som statsminister. Det är inte minst viktigt för att vi ska kunna få fler i arbete och stärka välfärden i hela landet, säger Tobias Baudin.

articles.body_text: Rysslands strategiska huvudvärk stavas Kaliningrad. Den tidigare så hotfulla exklaven är nu omringad av Nato och har förvandlats till en sårbarhet, enligt Försvarsstabens chef Carl-Johan Edström. Med Sverige och Finland i alliansen kan området blockeras och isoleras vid en konflikt. Kaliningrad har blivit ett militärt problem för Putin och Ryssland efter Sveriges och Finlands Nato-inträde. Nato vill kunna blockera och isolera exklaven vid konflikt. Gotland pekas ut som nyckel – och hotet om hybridkrig ökar. Sveriges och Finlands inträde i Nato har ritat om den militärstrategiska kartan i grunden. Den ryska exklaven Kaliningrad, tidigare ett offensivt hot, är inte bara en huvudvärk för Nato utan lika mycket ett ”stort militärt problem” för Ryssland , enligt Försvarsstabens chef, generallöjtnant Carl-Johan Edström. Med en ny Natostrategi och förstärkt närvaro i Baltikum syftar alliansen till att kunna blockera och isolera Kaliningradområdet vid en eventuell konflikt. De svenska och finska Natomedlemskapen har gjort att Östersjön blivit vad som i militära termer närmast kan beskrivas som ett Nato-innanhav. Det har satt den ryska exklaven Kaliningrad, inklämd mellan Polen och Litauen, i en helt ny och utsatt position. Det handlar då inte bara om Suwałkikorridoren och att kunna hålla flödena där, och/eller klara rörelsefriheten i Östersjön. Ur ryskt perspektiv beskriver Carl-Johan Edström Kaliningrad som ett stort militärt problem.

articles.title: Utbildning skulle vara gratis: ”Slavkontrakt”
articles.summary: Professionals Nord
articles.body_text: De lockar med gratis utbildning och fast anställning – på bara tolv veckor. Men studenter vittnar om osäkra villkor och risk att bli skyldiga tiotusentals kronor. Det visar Arbetets granskning av Satellite Groups yrkesutbildningar. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Utbildningarna marknadsförs som kostnadsfria i klipp på sociala medier. Lockbetet är en ny karriär inom järnvägen med kort utbildning. Men en granskning som Arbetet gjort av bemanningsföretaget Professionals Nord och koncernen Satellite Groups yrkesutbildningar visar en annan bild. När utbildningen ska dra i gång så presenteras ett avtal med villkor som innebär att den som avbryter utbildningen eller lämnar anställningen i förtid kan bli återbetalningsskyldig för utbildningskostnaden. I ett avtal som Arbetet tagit del av anges summan till 187 000 kronor. Deltagarna förbinder sig också att arbeta för Satellite Groups bemanningsbolag Professionals Nord, PN, i minst 18 månader. Enligt avtalet krävs minst 3 132 arbetade timmar för att bli skuldfri. Arbetet har talat med fem personer som gått utbildningarna. Flera vittnar om att de känt sig vilseledda. En av dem är ”William”, som egentligen heter något annat. Han avbröt upplägget i förtid och krävdes på 90 000 kronor. ”Det har satt väldigt djupa spår i mig, både personligen och ekonomiskt” , skriver han i ett sms till Arbetet.

articles.title: Ex-politikerna: Det talar för att Kristersson (M) blir statsminister
articles.summary: Just nu har Ulf Kristersson (M) medvind. Det är ex-politikerna Anna Kinberg Batra och Thomas Bodström överens om. – Det känns väldigt tomt i Magdalena Anderssons paket, säger Kinberg Batra i SVT:s ”Aktuellt”.
articles.body_text: Just nu har Ulf Kristersson (M) medvind. Det är ex-politikerna Anna Kinberg Batra och Thomas Bodström överens om. – Det känns väldigt tomt i Magdalena Anderssons paket, säger Kinberg Batra i SVT:s ”Aktuellt”. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Centerpartiet valde Socialdemokraternas ”totalpaket”. Men låsningen på den rödgröna sidan – Vänsterpartiets krav på ministerposter och Centerpartiets motstånd mot det – består. Av statsministerkandidaterna är det Moderaternas ledare Ulf Kristersson som har medvind just nu, tycker den tidigare M-ledaren Anna Kinberg Batra och den tidigare S-toppen Thomas Bodström. – Det känns tomt i Magdalena Anderssons paket. Antingen blir det en borgerlig mittenregering eller extraval, säger Kinberg Batra i ”Aktuellt”. Bodström tror fortfarande att S-ledaren har en liten fördel i kampen om regeringsmakten. – Magdalena Andersson blir statsminister. Men oddsen har sjunkit. Från 80-20 till 51-49 kanske. Man kan inte hålla på hur länge som helst och bråka. Det skapar ett dåligt underlag för att samarbeta i framtiden. Men det skapar också en möjlighet för Socialdemokraterna och Moderaterna. Ulf Kristersson skulle kunna vara kvar som statsminister – han gillar det ceremoniella, flyga regeringsplan – och Magdalena Andersson skulle kunna vara finansminister, säger han i sändningen. Kinberg Batra påpekar att C och V inte bara har oförenliga krav när det gäller regeringsmedverkan, utan även tycker väldigt olika sakpolitiskt. Bodström tror att Sverige får ett extra val om V inte backar från kravet på ministerposter. Han tror inte att Andersson skulle tvingas avgå som partiledare om hon misslyckas med att sy ihop en rödgrön regering, men att hon själv skulle tappa lusten att leda partiet.
